package_info.why_malicious: The report does not describe any specific malicious software package or code artifact. Instead, it summarizes several high-profile cyber-attacks, ransomware incidents, and vulnerabilities, but does not provide code-level details or package-based malware.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: No specific malware package or code-based attack is described in the report. Detection should focus on general behavioral indicators of ransomware, credential theft, and phishing, as well as monitoring for exploitation of the mentioned vulnerabilities (e.g., VMware Aria Automation, Citrix NetScaler, Atlassian Confluence).
